inverter.comment: mode 'tcp' = networked inverter or the simulator (host/port; real inverters use 502). mode 'serial' = RS-485 via USB adapter (uses the 'serial' block; port is COMx on Windows or /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux). device_id is the Modbus unit/slave id.

poller.comment: 3s is a safe poll rate per most inverter manuals (2-5s recommended). history_samples caps how many rows the dashboard charts request.

database.comment: SQLite file storing every reading so history survives restarts. Path is relative to the project root. Delete the file to reset, or if you change register_map.json.

mqtt.comment: Publishes each reading to an MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto on port 1883). Needs a broker running; if none is reachable the poller keeps working and reconnects automatically. Set enabled=false to turn off.

simulator.comment: time_speed 60 = one simulated day passes in 24 real minutes so you can watch the full solar curve. Set to 1 for real time.
